zoh.description: zero-order hold of the last leader packet (baseline)

advanced.description: PIDR + neighbour coupling + avoidance + gain scheduling (baseline)

adaptive_legacy.description: adaptive_comm, no supervisor (quality-threshold feed-forward scaling only)

adaptive_capped.description: adaptive_comm, no supervisor, TOTAL speed cap (the earlier prototype, kept for the discrepancy record)

sup_observe_only.description: supervisor runs but all caution modifiers are neutral (ablation control)

sup_speedlimit.description: supervisor + HOLD speed limit of 0.8 x max speed (the first design; measured harmful)

blackout_3s.description: 3 s total blackout at t=5 s (the original benchmark)

blackout_6s.description: 6 s total blackout at t=4 s

blackout_maneuver.description: 3 s blackout at t=5 s while the leader stops and turns abruptly

random_loss_30.description: independent 30 % extra packet loss, t=4-12 s

burst_loss.description: correlated burst loss (mean ~50 %, mean burst ~6.7 packets), t=4-12 s

profile.name: burst_loss
profile.description: correlated burst loss (two-state chain per link)

latency_jitter.description: +0.4 s latency with +-0.2 s jitter, t=4-12 s

latency_then_blackout.description: +0.3 s latency/jitter for 3 s then a 3 s blackout (t=3-9 s)

profile.name: blackout_latency
profile.description: latency/jitter window followed by a blackout
